description:
In repos/llm-resolver-vessel/src/index.ts, make exactly ONE single-line insertion. Do not make any other change.

The exact line
  ["llm_completion", llmCompletionWithPolicyHandler],
occurs exactly once in the file. Insert a new line immediately AFTER it, at the same two-space indentation, reading exactly:
  ["llmCompletion", llmCompletionWithPolicyHandler],

That is the whole change: one added entry in the `resolvers` Map, aliasing the camelCase shape name to the handler that already serves the snake_case one. The string `["llmCompletion", ` does not currently appear anywhere in the file, so there is no duplicate-key risk. No import is needed; llmCompletionWithPolicyHandler is already in scope on the line above.

THE DEFECT: this vessel ADVERTISES llmCompletion in two places — the static shapes array `shapes: ["llm_completion", "llmCompletion", "llmModelPolicy", "llmModelPolicy_write", "llmQuotaState"],` and the dynamic re-advertisement `shapes.unshift("llm_completion", "llmCompletion");` — but the resolvers Map has no llmCompletion key, and VesselDaemon returns HTTP 404 `no resolver for '<type>'` on a Map miss. VERIFIED LIVE from inside the container, most recently minutes ago: POST http://127.0.0.1:8220/resolve with {"type":"llmCompletion","prompt":"ping"} returns 404 while the identical request using "llm_completion" returns 200. Any walk backward-chaining from llmCompletion finds this vessel as the sole producer via the discovery registry and then gets a 404, so the LLM plane appears reachable through that shape and is not. A comment near the advertisement asserts "so the advertised set and the routable set never disagree"; they disagree.

WHY ADD THE ALIAS RATHER THAN REMOVE THE ADVERTISEMENT: llmCompletion is this vessel's OUTPUT shape, so de-advertising it would delete the edge a walk uses to find a producer for that shape. Adding the alias is purely additive, cannot break existing routing, and makes the existing advertisement true. The same fix was already applied for this defect class in repos/local-tools-vessel/src/index.ts.

Do NOT modify the shapes array, the shapes.unshift call, the hasCompletionQuota branch, or any handler implementation. Do not rename anything.
